Date: Thu, 1 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Accelerator cohort — pilot credit request

Hi Olga,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the latency numbers look great.

We’re in the final stretch for our Accelerator cohort kickoff (starts Oct 18) and I’m trying to lock in infrastructure credits for the top 10 teams. Your standard accelerator allotment will cover most needs, but a few teams (early infra / LLM-heavy) will need an extra top-up to hit the onboarding milestones.

Request: can Redwood provide a one-time supplemental pilot credit of 50k tokens (or equivalent $ value) for 3 teams, conditional on hitting a usage milestone in month 1? We can commit to sharing a short mutual action plan and a brief case study if that helps.

Attached: cohort roster + brief usage estimates (flywheel_map_v1.xlsx).

Happy to jump on a call this afternoon.

Sara Klein
Head of Programs | Flywheel Labs
sara@flywheellabs.com
+1 (415) 555-0194

Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — pilot credit request

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and the file. This is the right kind of ask. Quick thoughts:

- We typically cap accelerator top-ups at 30k tokens per team under the standard program.
- We can consider a conditional exception if Flywheel agrees to a milestone-based release and a short public case study (2-3 paragraphs) after month 1.
- Need approvals from Sales Ops and Legal for anything >30k per team.

Can you confirm the exact teams (names) and the milestone you want to tie the release to (e.g., "30k tokens used within 30 days post-onboarding" or "demo-ready pipeline with 3 live prompts")? I’ll loop in Ops and Legal to speed the review.

I’m copying Ben (for credits/budget) and Neha (legal quick review). If everyone is aligned, I’ll draft the conditional credit addendum and the activation schedule.

—Olga
Olga Petrov
Partner Programs | Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>

Cc: Sara Klein <sara@flywheellabs.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Oct 2026 08:30:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Accelerator cohort — pilot credit request

Looping in a few internal notes and a proposal for structure.

Olga/Sara — thanks for flagging. Operational constraints: our accelerator pool state today would allow a one-off uplift, but if we go to 50k per team for 3 teams that’s larger than standard. Suggested path:

1) Offer 30k tokens per team immediately (standard exception).
2) Provide an additional 20k per team as a conditional top-up that is released when Flywheel publishes the cohort case study (public) and when each team consumes >=25k tokens in the first 30 days.
3) Attach a 90-day usage cap to prevent runaway spend and require a simple monthly usage report.

Neha — can Legal sign off on a one-page addendum that expresses the conditions above and includes a simple indemnity clause? If yes, we’ll share the addendum with Flywheel and a DocuSign link.

Marissa — can we reserve the earmarked credits against the accelerator budget (provisionally)?

Thanks — Ben
Director of Partnerships | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Date: Mon, 4 Oct 2026 10:40:12 -0700

Thanks Ben — OLGA / team, I can provisionally mark the credits in the accelerator fund through EOM October to avoid double-spend. Two operational asks before we finalize:

- Please confirm the exact milestone language you want in the addendum (Ben suggested >=25k tokens in first 30 days + public case study).
- Confirm which exact 3 teams receive the extra allocation (I can’t mark anonymous buckets).

I drafted a short addendum (see attached stub) and uploaded it for signature: redwood_mop_addendum_v1.pdf. Legal: I left the indemnity light — Neha, please iterate if you need stronger protections but keep it single page.

If Flywheel confirms the teams and milestone today we can get DocuSign out tomorrow and provisionally allocate the resources.

Best,
